divergences.old: deps frisk --source sonatypeiq scanning the git repository it ran in (transitive dependencies included by default), and failing with "Not inside a git repository." elsewhere
divergences.toil: toil sonatypeiq application evaluate (deps frisk is an alias) reads an inventory from --from <file>, or from stdin on the CLI: toil deps scan --include-transitive | toil sonatypeiq application evaluate <id>. --ecosystem, --direct-only and --include-dev filter the inventory as they filtered the scan
divergences.why: One command talks to one source and the caller composes them (decision 6 on #68). Scanning is deps scan's job; this command only asks IQ Server.

divergences.old: deps frisk --source sonatypeiq pinging the public OSV service and Artifactory (with the Artifactory token) before evaluating, and reporting tier as full, artifactory or local from their answers
divergences.toil: Only IQ Server is contacted. tier is always "full": the vulnerability source the command names answered
divergences.why: toil sends traffic only to hosts the command names; this one names Sonatype IQ Server, so a credential for another service and a call to a public API have no business here.

divergences.old: An absolute resultsUrl from the evaluation answer fetched as given, on any host, with the IQ user token; a relative one glued onto baseUrl as text
divergences.toil: The URL is built as the contract records, then one on another host (a glued slash-less relative URL included) is re-pointed at the connection's host, keeping its path and query, with a SONATYPEIQ_RESULTS_HOST warning
divergences.why: The user token goes only to the host it's configured for (suspected bug #91 item 1).

divergences.old: The evaluation's application lookup, POST and polls sent with fetch directly: no 429 retry, redirects followed to any host, an empty body failing to parse
divergences.toil: They go through core's HTTP layer like the area's other commands: a 429 is retried, a redirect to another host is refused (on the lookup, that counts as a failed lookup, so the public ID is used), and an empty body is an HTTP error saying so
divergences.why: Credentials stay on the connection's host, and every request in toil is sent one way. The answers are otherwise the same.
